map.流量换算：单位为 L/s 时 Q = 流量 ÷ 1000，否则 Q = 流量 ÷: Flow conversion: in L/s Q = flow÷1000, otherwise Q = flow÷3600 (m³/s); diameter D = mm value÷1000 (m); Hazen-Williams friction head loss hf = 10.67×length×Q^1.852÷(C^1.852×D^4.87) (m); pressure drop ΔP = hf×9.80665 (kPa, water basis); pipe velocity v = Q÷(π×(D÷2)²) (m/s); flow and length must be non-negative and diameter and C greater than 0.
